answer: New agents plant a seed bond: 5,000 POA locked 90 days in a slashing contract. Signup needs a TPM hardware quote plus a signed identity commitment, and the registry kernel hashes both into one record no second key can replay. Bonds release after 90 days of peer attestation with no duplicate. Two identities sharing a commitment root get both bonds burned and the hardware ID banned. A 10,000-sock-puppet farm costs 50 million POA burned, 10,000 TPMs, and three months of waiting. An orchard where every tree posts a bond before it fruits; the grove burns any tree grown from a copied seed.
